statements.status_notes: Codehaus Jackson 1.x deserialization can admit unsafe types without a sufficient allowlist. The report covers a family of deserialization gadgets rather than proving that every application is exploitable. The shipped mapper has base version 1.9.13; its application type restrictions, available gadget classes and any vendor-specific hardening remain unverified. The advisory identifies no upstream 1.x fixed release. Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 ships this code inside vendor-assembled bundles. Changing a standalone library dependency does not replace that bundled implementation; a compatible vendor release or validated bundle remediation and application-specific applicability assessment remain unresolved. A base-version scanner match alone does not establish exploitability. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-c27h-mcmw-48hv.

The Codehaus Jackson 1.x XML-binding implementation is reported to permit XML external entity resolution in classes beyond the earlier CVE-2016-3720 fix. The vendor runtime includes mapper 1.9.13 base code. Whether the affected XML-binding classes and configuration are exposed, or IBM has separately hardened this copy, remains unverified; an upstream 1.x patched version is not identified by the advisory. Open Liberty 26.0.0.11 ships this code inside vendor-assembled bundles. Changing a standalone library dependency does not replace that bundled implementation; a compatible vendor release or validated bundle remediation and application-specific applicability assessment remain unresolved. A base-version scanner match alone does not establish exploitability. See https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-r6j9-8759-g62w.
